mapper.select: SELECT p.name as name, o.order_id as orderId, oi.price as price, p.image as image, o.totalamount as amount, oi.quantity as quantity, o.order_date as date, u.username as user FROM "EcommerceBackendDb".orders o JOIN "EcommerceBackendDb".order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN "EcommerceBackendDb".product p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN "EcommerceBackendDb".user u ON o.customer_id = u.email ORDER BY o.order_date DESC;

SELECT p.name as name, o.order_id as orderId, oi.price as price, p.image as image, o.totalamount as amount, oi.quantity as quantity, o.order_date as date FROM "EcommerceBackendDb".orders o JOIN "EcommerceBackendDb".order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN "EcommerceBackendDb".product p ON oi.product_id = p.id
where o.customer_id=#{userId} ORDER BY o.order_date DESC;
